description.blurb: S/2019 S 6 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Inuit group. It was discovered in 2019 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2019 S 6 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 18.2 million km in 916.7 days. It has an inclination of 48.1° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.084.
